description_en: Queries whether the DNS settings of a domain name are correct
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-dns-record --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-nwy0000is02 --domain xxx.aliyundoc.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainDNSRecord

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

DNSStatus.description_en:
The DNS status. Valid values:

cnameMatched: Normal.

vipMatched: A record.

wafVip: The VIP of another WAF is used.

unRecord: No DNS resolution is configured.

unUsed: Traffic does not pass through WAF.

checkTimeout: The detection timed out
DNSStatus.description_zh:
DNS状态。取值：

cnameMatched：表示正常。

vipMatched：表示A记录。

wafVip：表示使用其他WAF的VIP。

unRecord：表示没有DNS解析。

unUsed：表示未过WAF。

checkTimeout：表示检测超时
